project_prompt:
Redesign of the CNCF Peshawar chapter website in the MotherDuck neo-brutalist technical-playful design system on warm cream paper with monospace typography and hard offset shadows.

DESIGN SYSTEM (REQUIRED):
- Platform: Web, responsive (desktop 1200px container, mobile-first 390px layout)
- Theme: Light, neo-brutalist technical-playful
- Background Canvas: Cream Paper (#f4efea)
- Card / Panel Surface: Frost White (#ffffff)
- Tertiary / Wash Surface: Chalk Gray (#f8f8f7)
- Borders & Universal Ink: Charcoal Ink (#383838) at 1.5px–2px solid (never pure black #000000)
- Primary Action / CTA Fill: Sky Crayon (#6fc2ff) with Charcoal Ink (#383838) text
- Highlight / Marquee Background: Canary Banner (#ffde00)
- Secondary Accent: Duck Bill Orange (#ff9538)
- Rainbow Outline Palette (Rotating DOM Order): Coral (#f38e84), Peach (#f5b161), Mint (#38c1b0), Lilac (#b291de), Lime (#b3c419), Periwinkle (#7597ee), Slate (#84a6bc), Marigold (#e1c427)
- Muted Text (WCAG AA compliant): #6b6b6b (replaces #a1a1a1 for readable text; #a1a1a1 reserved for disabled outlines only)
- Typography: JetBrains Mono / Aeonik Mono (weights 300, 400, 500, 600; tracking +0.02em); Inter allowed for long-form blog prose
- Geometry: 2px border radius strictly everywhere (buttons, cards, badges, inputs, nav)
- Elevation: Zero-blur hard drop shadow rgb(56, 56, 56) -6px 6px 0px 0px on interactive cards and buttons
- Interactive Press: translate(-6px, 6px) with shadow collapsing to 0 on hover/active
- Focus State: :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #383838; outline-offset: 3px }
- Minimum Text Size: 12px floor for all readable copy; fluid clamp() for hero display headlines

Target Routes & Scope:
1. / (Home): Centered hero (JetBrains Mono 300), charter terminal frame, Canary marquee, 4 key facts cards, featured countdown card, 2x2 pillar bento grid, archives, CFP banner, sponsors strip, footer.
2. /events (Events Directory): Hero, upcoming meetup featured card, past events archive grid, CFP strip.
3. /events/[slug] (Event Detail): Two-column layout (Markdown content left, sticky info/RSVP card right).
4. /speak (Speaker CFP): 3 format cards (15m, 40m, 90m) in rainbow sketch borders, proposal support steps, CFP issue link CTA.
5. /sponsors (Sponsors & Impact): 4 package cards, interactive proposal builder frame with 2px form inputs and live terminal proposal preview, prospectus link.
6. /team (Team Directory): Core leads with 2px bordered portrait cards, white name labels, working group cards in rotating sketch colors.
7. /team/[group] (Working Group): Responsive member card grid, social links, back navigation.
8. /blog (Blog Archive): Post list cards with tag chips, author metadata, publication dates.
9. /blog/[slug] (Article Detail): 720px measure container, Inter body typography, monospaced headings.
10. /code-of-conduct (Code of Conduct): Formal Linux Foundation / CNCF community guidelines prose layout.
11. /404 (Error Page): Technical-playful 404 terminal readout on cream canvas.

Frozen Hooks & Contract Constraints (42 Asserted Selectors from CONTRACT.md §5):
All 42 hooks must be preserved verbatim in markup and client interactions:
- Anchor & Structure: #main-content, #email-builder, #tiers
- Navigation: #mobile-nav-toggle, #mobile-nav-drawer, aria-label="Main Navigation", aria-label="Toggle navigation menu", aria-expanded, aria-controls="mobile-nav-drawer", aria-hidden, aria-current="page"
- Genesis Countdown: .countdown-card, data-target, #genesis-countdown, #cd-days, #cd-hours, #cd-mins, #cd-secs, #cd-live-dot, #cd-live-label, #cd-date-display, #cd-actions, #cd-rsvp-btn
- Sponsorship Builder: #sponsor-form, #org-name, #contact-name, #contact-email, #tier-select, #timeline-select, #org-website, #scope-notes, #email-preview-text, #send-mailto-btn, #copy-template-btn, #copy-btn-text, aria-live="polite"
- Social & A11y Links: aria-label="Open Community Groups", aria-label="CNCF Slack", aria-label="GitHub", aria-label="LinkedIn", aria-label="Instagram"
- Routes: Exact href paths (/, /events, /speak, /sponsors, /team, /blog, /code-of-conduct, /admin/)
